| `records.spaces` | link-projects-records | — | link-runs-usage, mod-chat, mod-projects, mod-runs, mod-wiki | no | Inter-module port through which the projects link module gives feature modules the project records database for a space name (this link module is the only implementation) |
| `resources.lookup` | mod-resources | — | link-definitions-resources, link-definitions-teams, link-runs-teams | no | Port through which the resources module gives link modules resource definition and content lookup (this module is the only implementation) |
| `resources.types` | mod-resources | link-definitions-resources | link-definitions-teams, link-runs-teams | no | Port through which the resources module gives link modules the registry of registered resource types. New types use the `resource-type` extension point |
| `runs.events` | mod-runs | link-chat-runs, link-logs-runs, link-runs-trace, link-runs-usage | — | no | Port through which the runs module gives link modules run event lookup (this module is the only implementation) |
| `runs.move_hook` | mod-runs | — | link-chat-runs | no | Port through which the runs module gives the chat link module the hook that moves runs along with a moved conversation |
| `runs.preparers` | link-runs-teams | — | mod-runs | yes | Inter-module multi-provider port through which the teams link module adds pre-run checks and preparation to the runs module |
| `runs.reader` | mod-runs | link-chat-runs, link-logs-runs, link-runs-sdd, link-runs-trace, link-runs-usage | link-projects-records | no | Port through which the runs module gives link modules Run and NodeRun lookup (this module is the only implementation) |
| `runs.resume_handlers` | link-chat-runs | — | mod-runs | yes | Inter-module multi-provider port through which the chat link module adds resume handlers to the runs module |
| `runs.scopes` | link-memory-runs, link-projects-runs, link-wiki-runs | — | mod-runs | yes |  |
| `runs.services` | link-runs-teams, link-wiki-runs | — | mod-runs | yes | Inter-module multi-provider port through which link modules add node services to the runs module. To add tools to each run, use the `run-scope` and `agent-tool-provider` extension points |
| `runs.session_archive` | mod-runs | — | link-projects-records | no | Port through which the runs module gives the project records link module the session archive for a backend id. Archiving for a new backend is the `backend-session-archive` extension point |
| `runs.starter` | mod-runs | link-chat-runs, link-runs-sdd, link-runs-teams | — | no | Port through which the runs module gives link modules run start, validation, and cancellation (this module is the only implementation) |
| `sdd.integrations` | link-runs-sdd | — | mod-sdd | yes |  |
| `sdd.service` | mod-sdd | link-runs-sdd | — | no | Service port that the specs module gives link modules (this module is the only implementation) |
| `sdd.spaces` | link-projects-sdd | — | mod-sdd | no | Inter-module port through which the projects link module provides the spec storage for a space name |
| `sdd.verification_sources` | link-runs-sdd | — | mod-sdd | yes |  |
| `secrets.redact` | mod-runs | — | link-definitions-teams | no | Port through which the runs module gives link modules masking of resolved secret values (this module is the only implementation) |
| `secrets.rules` | mod-definitions | — | link-definitions-resources, link-definitions-teams, mod-exports, mod-imports, mod-logs, mod-projects, mod-runs, mod-sdd, mod-versions, mod-wiki | no | Port through which the definitions module shares the current secret detection rules (user settings) with other modules. To add a place to look up secret values, use the `secret-provider` extension point |
| `server.attributes` | mod-runs | — | — | yes | Host port through which modules add properties to the server info (GET /server-info). It is covered as a common part of writing modules (the server module guide) |
| `server.warnings` | link-projects-records, mod-architecture, mod-chat, mod-definitions, mod-i18n, mod-logs, mod-memory, mod-runs, mod-sdd, mod-usage, mod-wiki | — | — | yes | Host port through which modules add warnings to the server info (GET /server-info). It is covered as a common part of writing modules (the server module guide) |
| `settings.scope_layers` | link-projects-runs | — | link-definitions-teams, link-exports-teams | yes |  |
| `usage.event_query` | link-runs-usage | — | mod-usage | no | Inter-module port through which the runs and usage link module gives the usage module run event lookup (that link module is the only implementation) |
| `usage.service` | mod-usage | link-logs-usage | — | no | Port through which the usage module tells link modules that it is present and offers its reporting service (this module is the only implementation) |
| `usage.sources` | link-logs-usage | — | mod-usage | yes |  |
| `usage.token_rollups` | link-runs-usage | — | mod-usage | no | Inter-module port through which the runs and usage link module provides token totals for platform runs (that link module is the only implementation) |
| `wiki.integrations` | link-wiki-runs | — | mod-wiki | yes | Inter-module port that announces the capability names that storage link modules turn on (only names that the wiki module knows have any meaning) |
| `wiki.service` | mod-wiki | link-wiki-runs | — | no | Service port that the wiki module gives link modules (this module is the only implementation) |
| `wiki.spaces` | link-projects-wiki | — | mod-wiki | no | Inter-module port through which the projects link module provides the wiki storage for a space name |
| `wiki.write_checks` | — | — | mod-wiki | yes |  |
| `workspace.settings` | mod-definitions | — | link-definitions-teams, link-exports-teams, link-runs-teams, mod-architecture, mod-chat, mod-logs, mod-memory, mod-runs, mod-sdd, mod-usage, mod-wiki | no | Port through which the definitions module shares the current workspace settings with other modules (this module is the only implementation) |
